name: Long-Term Bun Mart Refresh Plan
description: Replace mart_refresh_queue with a durable project refresh ledger, bounded article dirtiness, worker-owned refresh execution, and token-based prompt visibility so review pages, counts, warnings, and prompt queueing update automatically without the Bun or macOS queue workaround.

userStories.title: Add project refresh ledger schema
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want `app.project_mart_refresh_state` to persist dirty tokens, completion tokens, lease state, and refresh status so project refresh orchestration has one durable source of truth.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a DuckDB migration for `app.project_mart_refresh_state` with `project_id`, dirty and completion token fields, worker and lease fields, refresh status, timestamps, and indexes for claim and stale-work queries.
Thread the new ledger fields through the repo's schema typing so services and tests can use them without parallel ad hoc types.
`bun run dev:server` stays up cleanly and logs show no Bun native crash signatures or code 133 restart loops

userStories.title: Add bounded article dirtiness schema
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want bounded per-project article dirtiness storage so the worker can refresh unresolved judgment facts without recreating row-per-event fanout.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a DuckDB migration for `app.project_mart_refresh_article_state` with one row per `(project_id, article_id)` and token range fields such as `first_dirty_token` and `last_dirty_token`.
The schema supports widening token ranges for repeated dirtiness instead of inserting one row per `(project, article, token)` event.
`bun run dev:server` stays up cleanly and logs show no Bun native crash signatures or code 133 restart loops

userStories.title: Implement atomic refresh state service
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want one service to atomically mark projects dirty, resolve unresolved articles, claim work, and complete or fail refreshes so refresh state cannot split across partial writes.
acceptanceCriteria: Dirty-token bumping and article-dirtiness merging happen atomically per project, and completion trims resolved article state through the completed token.
Service tests cover repeated marks, lease expiry recovery, unresolved-range reads, completion trimming, and failure recording.
`bun run dev:server` stays up cleanly and logs show no Bun native crash signatures or code 133 restart loops

userStories.title: Upgrade SQLite job scan state to token ack fields
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want per-job SQLite `job_scan_state` files to migrate in place from seq-based refresh acknowledgement fields to token-based fields so prompt visibility can follow the new ledger safely.
acceptanceCriteria: Add an in-place upgrade path in `src/server/cron/judgmentsJobs/judgmentJobSqliteService.ts` that migrates existing `job_scan_state` rows from `last_project_refresh_ack_seq` and `wrap_visibility_ack_seq` to token-based equivalents.
Older per-job SQLite DBs upgrade safely without delete-and-recreate semantics or data loss.
`bun run dev:server` stays up cleanly and logs show no Bun native crash signatures or code 133 restart loops

userStories.title: Mark dirty from imported and direct LLM judgments
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want imported and directly persisted LLM judgments to mark all affected projects dirty so new judgments always feed the refresh ledger instead of relying on mart queue writes.
acceptanceCriteria: Replace direct mart queue writes in judgment import and direct judgment persistence paths with `markProjectsDirtyAtomically` or a durable outbox or reconciliation path when the same outer transaction is not available.
Changed article ids resolve to all active, non-archived affected projects before dirty state is recorded.
`bun run dev:server` stays up cleanly and logs show no Bun native crash signatures or code 133 restart loops

userStories.title: Mark dirty from human assessment writes
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want human assessment updates to mark affected projects dirty in the same transaction boundary when possible so review completeness changes propagate automatically.
acceptanceCriteria: Update human assessment write paths to resolve affected projects and record dirty state through `markProjectsDirtyAtomically` or a durable outbox or reconciliation record when the same outer transaction is not feasible.
Assessment updates that change review completeness or article review state feed the project ledger instead of queueing article refresh rows.
`bun run dev:server` stays up cleanly and logs show no Bun native crash signatures or code 133 restart loops

userStories.title: Mark dirty from prompt and project config mutations
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want project and prompt mutations to record both project dirtiness and affected article ids when they rewrite judgments or scope so config changes rebuild the correct downstream marts.
acceptanceCriteria: Update `ProjectsRoutes`, `PromptsRoutes`, and `SubprojectsRoutes` mutation paths to record dirty state through `markProjectsDirtyAtomically` or a durable outbox or reconciliation record.
Prompt merge and invalid-judgment flows merge affected article ids into bounded article dirtiness instead of treating these changes as project-dirty-only mutations.
`bun run dev:server` stays up cleanly and logs show no Bun native crash signatures or code 133 restart loops

userStories.title: Mark dirty from membership and datasource scope mutations
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want article membership and datasource scope changes to dirty the right projects so project scope updates no longer depend on mart queue writes.
acceptanceCriteria: Update project-article membership and datasource import-scope mutation paths to record dirty state through `markProjectsDirtyAtomically` or a durable outbox or reconciliation record.
Membership and import-scope writes record dirty state in the same outer transaction where feasible.
`bun run dev:server` stays up cleanly and logs show no Bun native crash signatures or code 133 restart loops

userStories.title: Build the core refresh worker loop
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a worker-owned claim and refresh loop so project refresh orchestration moves out of the hot API path and runs deterministically under the writer-role model.
acceptanceCriteria: Add `src/server/workers/projectMartRefreshWorker.ts` and `scripts/runProjectMartRefreshWorker.ts` with a single-project-at-a-time claim loop.

For a claimed project, the worker loads unresolved article ids for `(last_completed_refresh_token, claimed_token]`, refreshes judgment facts first, runs `refreshProject(projectId)` second, and records completion or failure.
Worker tests cover claim, order of operations, success, failure, and expired-lease recovery.
`bun run dev:server` stays up cleanly and logs show no Bun native crash signatures or code 133 restart loops

userStories.title: Publish token-based SQLite refresh ack with reconciliation
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want worker-owned token-based ack publication to update every relevant per-job SQLite DB and be replayable after crashes so prompt visibility and retention pruning stay correct.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement token-based ack publication that fans out to every relevant per-job SQLite DB for a project instead of assuming one job per project.
Ack publication is idempotent, derived from ledger state, and replayable by reconciliation without rerunning the refresh pipeline.
Tests cover token ack fanout, replay after a simulated post-completion crash, and retention-pruning correctness when ack publication is replayed.
`bun run dev:server` stays up cleanly and logs show no Bun native crash signatures or code 133 restart loops

userStories.title: Remove legacy seq-based ack writes from SQLite importer
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want the SQLite outbox importer to stop publishing seq-based refresh acknowledgement so the worker becomes the only source of truth for token-based refresh visibility.
acceptanceCriteria: `src/server/cron/judgmentsJobs/judgmentJobSqliteOutboxImport.ts` no longer writes legacy seq-based refresh ack state after importing judgments.
The importer still imports judgments, records dirty state, and leaves token-based ack publication to the worker or reconciler.
`bun run dev:server` stays up cleanly and logs show no Bun native crash signatures or code 133 restart loops

userStories.title: Gate strict count and unassessed endpoints on ledger freshness
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want strict-correctness count and unassessed endpoints to bypass stale marts so behavior stays correct while refresh work is running or recovering.
acceptanceCriteria: Add freshness gating in `src/services/olap/duckdbOlap.ts` and `src/server/routes/JudgmentsJobsRoutes.ts` so strict count and unassessed endpoints use raw fallback or another non-stale path when ledger freshness is not satisfied.
Invalidate the unassessed-count cache when relevant dirty state is recorded and ensure the unassessed preview endpoint reflects freshness correctly.
`bun run dev:server` stays up cleanly and logs show no Bun native crash signatures or code 133 restart loops

userStories.title: Migrate prompt queue visibility and pruning to token semantics
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want prompt queue builder visibility and SQLite retention pruning to use token-based ack state so queueing no longer depends on legacy seq watermarks.
acceptanceCriteria: Update `judgmentsJobsCronGetPrompts.ts`, `judgmentsJobsAddToQueue.ts`, and `judgmentJobSqliteService.ts` to use token-based visibility and pruning semantics instead of seq-based ack semantics.
Prompt queue builder paths do not silently trust stale marts, and wrapped or raw scan visibility stays correct relative to completed refresh work.
`bun run dev:server` stays up cleanly and logs show no Bun native crash signatures or code 133 restart loops

userStories.title: Gate direct review-detail mart reads
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want the review detail route to avoid silently trusting stale `mart.review_article_serving_detail` rows so detail views follow the same freshness contract as the rest of review serving.
acceptanceCriteria: Update `src/server/routes/projectsRoutes/projectsRoutesPostArticleReviewDetails.ts` to prefer fresh serving detail rows and fall back or surface explicit freshness state when the ledger is stale or running.
Route tests prove review detail no longer silently trusts stale `mart.review_article_serving_detail` rows.
`bun run dev:server` stays up cleanly and logs show no Bun native crash signatures or code 133 restart loops

userStories.title: Preserve reviews warnings backend contract
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want the reviews warnings route to map ledger and worker state into the existing warnings and progress contract so review pages keep a clear freshness signal during migration.
acceptanceCriteria: Update `src/server/routes/projectsRoutes/projectsRoutesGetReviewsWarnings.ts` to produce stale, running, failed, and progress semantics from the new ledger and worker state.
Route tests cover ready, refreshing, stale, and failed warning states without depending on `app.mart_refresh_queue`.
`bun run dev:server` stays up cleanly and logs show no Bun native crash signatures or code 133 restart loops

userStories.title: Update reviews warnings frontend for the ledger-backed contract
userStories.description: As a user, I want review warning banners and progress UI to keep working during the refresh-worker migration so the page stays explicit about stale or rebuilding review data.
acceptanceCriteria: Update `reviewsWarningsQuery.ts`, `reviewsIndexingProgress.tsx`, and `reviewsProjectWarnings.tsx` to consume the preserved or intentionally migrated warnings contract from the new backend route.
The UI still shows clear stale or running messaging and progress details on review pages when refresh work is incomplete.
`bun run dev:server` stays up cleanly and logs show no Bun native crash signatures or code 133 restart loops
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Retire legacy runtime mart queue surfaces
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want the live API and worker runtime to stop depending on `app.mart_refresh_queue` so Bun or macOS no longer needs the old queue-disable workaround.
acceptanceCriteria: Remove legacy queue-on-write and heartbeat runtime assumptions from `getDuckdbMartRefreshService.ts` and `martRefreshDrainHeartbeat.ts` while keeping direct refresh primitives that the new worker still needs.
Archived-project cleanup deletes the new refresh-state and bounded article-state rows instead of depending on `app.mart_refresh_queue` cleanup.
`bun run dev:server` stays up cleanly and logs show no Bun native crash signatures or code 133 restart loops

userStories.title: Migrate recovery and maintenance scripts off the old queue
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want recovery and maintenance scripts to stop reading or writing the old mart queue so emergency and cleanup tooling remain usable after queue retirement.
acceptanceCriteria: Update the archived-refresh and SQLite recovery scripts to use the new refresh state or replacement manual flows instead of `app.mart_refresh_queue`.
Recovery and cleanup smoke tests prove the scripts still operate after queue retirement.
`bun run dev:server` stays up cleanly and logs show no Bun native crash signatures or code 133 restart loops

userStories.title: Add incremental article-aware refresh routing
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want the stable worker to choose incremental article refreshes for small deltas so the system can reduce full-project rebuild cost without giving up correctness.
acceptanceCriteria: Add threshold-based routing that chooses between full project refresh and `refreshJudgmentArticle(articleId)` plus `refreshProjectArticleServing(projectId, articleId)` for small deltas.
Correctness tests prove review pages, counts, warnings, and prompt queueing still match the full-refresh behavior after incremental routing is enabled.
`bun run dev:server` stays up cleanly and logs show no Bun native crash signatures or code 133 restart loops
